fields.name: centerPrice
docs: Initial center price: a normalized ratio scaled by PRICE_PRECISION (10^15)

fields.name: revenueCut
docs: Revenue cut in 4 decimals (e.g., 100000 = 10%). Divided by 10000 for storage.

fields.name: upperShiftThreshold
docs: Upper shift threshold percent in 4 decimals. Divided by 1000 for storage.

fields.name: lowerShiftThreshold
docs: Lower shift threshold percent in 4 decimals. Divided by 1000 for storage.

fields.name: thresholdShiftTime
docs: Time (seconds) for threshold-based center price shift

fields.name: swap0To1
docs: `true` = token0 in / token1 out; `false` = token1 in / token0 out.

fields.name: maker
docs: Signer that paid the input tokens — GeckoTerminal's `maker`.

fields.name: to
docs: Account that received the output tokens.

fields.name: amountIn
docs: Total input transferred by `maker`, fee inclusive.

fields.name: feeAmountIn
docs: Swap fee charged on the input token: a subset of `amount_in`, inclusive of
the protocol revenue cut. Rounded DOWN to native units.

fields.name: reservesToken0
docs: Pooled token0 after this swap — smart-collateral real reserves plus
smart-debt real reserves. Rounded DOWN to native units.

fields.name: reservesToken1
docs: Pooled token1 after this swap. Rounded DOWN to native units.

fields.name: poolPrice
docs: Post-swap pool (marginal) price, token1 per token0, 1e15 scale. This is NOT
the execution price of this swap (`amount_out / amount_in`): it is the ratio
of the post-swap imaginary reserves on whichever leg routed the larger
amount, so it excludes the swap fee and the slippage this swap paid.
Reserves are normalized to 9 decimals internally, so `pool_price / 1e15` is
already the whole-token price of token0 in token1 — no further decimal
